_comment: What Merit buys at the guild counter. Rank index 0..5 = E..S. 'form' editor IDs are resolved by tools/EspGen against the vanilla masters (a typo fails the build).
_library: Guild Library: for each skill, the next vanilla skill book the player hasn't read. Book N (1-5) needs rank N-1 and costs meritByTier[N-1].
_tomes: Spell tomes useful to any adventurer, regardless of school.
_supplies: Potions, bought one at a time.
_training: Guild Training: a permanent +amount to max Health / Stamina / Magicka per purchase, at most perRank purchases per stat for each guild rank reached (E = perRank, D = 2*perRank ...). Purchase n (1-based) costs baseMerit + stepMerit*(n-1). Max purchases per stat = perRank*6 (the ESP carries that many steps).
